verdict.rationale: Exa documents scheduled searches that surface new web events, and Websets fire real-time HTTP callbacks (webhooks) when items are added or enriched. Websets also apply user-defined criteria and enrichment fields to every matching result automatically. Together these give a scheduled, event-driven automation path, but there is no evidence of a general user-defined rule engine that maps a condition to an arbitrary action. missing for 10: a documented rule/condition-to-action configuration, details on scheduled-search (monitor) setup and trigger options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation working.
